upload_handling.notes: Multi-file PDF uploads to Supabase with RLS-aligned paths; signed URLs generated; handles auth/guest modes. No guided zones for source types (contract/proposal/emails).
blockers: No source-type validation or separate zones for Excel/.msg

source_parsing.notes: Solid for PDFs: text extraction, essentials (e.g., contract_number), section splits (heading-based), risks (waterproofing-specific). Uses Grok API with tailored prompts. No table/image handling; risks AI-generated, not DB-triggered.

multi_source_merging.notes: No CSI tree build or merging logic; parses files independently without combining into structured JSON (e.g., {csi_codes: {...}}).

trigger_integration.notes: Risks are open AI-flagged, not from risk_triggers DB table. Admin page exists for triggers, but not wired to Phase 1A flow.
blockers: No fetch/apply logic in hook or actions

pm_review_editing.notes: Display tables for essentials/risks/generated, but no interactive editing (e.g., forms/tree view for CSI verification/re-run triggers).

exhibit_generation.notes: Mock generation from risks (configurable type/context); waterproofing-focused stubs. No real AI/Claude for clauses; not from DB triggers/clauses.
blockers: No integration with trigger clauses or exhibit formatting

commit_to_db.notes: No insert to jobs/job_drafts (e.g., raw_uploads JSONB, scope_details_json). Transient state only.
blockers: Schema adds pending; depends on review/editing

one_click_email.notes: Toast stub in layout/page; no real email integration (e.g., Supabase edge funcs).

gaps: CSI tree merging and DB persistence
Downstream ties to later phases (e.g., submittals pull CSI)
next_prioritized_actions: Add Excel handling and initial merge logic in lib_phase-hook.ts
Add editable CSI tree in PhaseLayout
Test end-to-end with sample files (e.g., Greenway proposal)
